context: Tests whether the agent walks chart→subchart-sources→clone→tag-checkout→Dockerfile correctly, reports all FROMs from multi-stage builds, and records the resolution signal and currency-table date in the output.

checklist.name: Both output artifacts present
checklist.description: Working directory contains both base-audit-tree.txt AND base-audit.json at the end of the run.

checklist.name: chart-sources signal recorded
checklist.description: base-audit.json records the resolution-signal for the fdb-kubernetes-operator image as chart-sources (sourced from the subchart's Chart.yaml sources field), not slug-heuristic or oci-label.

checklist.name: Stripped /tree/ suffix from clone URL
checklist.description: The cloned repo URL is github.com/FoundationDB/fdb-kubernetes-operator (the repo root), not the chart-sources URL verbatim (which ends in /tree/main/charts/fdb-operator).

checklist.name: Release tag checked out
checklist.description: The report indicates the Dockerfile was read from the v2.27.0 tag, not from HEAD. Look for a tag-checkout marker in base-audit.json or a textual hint in base-audit-tree.txt.

checklist.name: All multi-stage FROMs reported
checklist.description: The output includes BOTH FROM stages of the operator Dockerfile (the golang:1.x builder AND the rockylinux/rockylinux:9.x-minimal runtime). Reporting only the runtime FROM is a fail.

checklist.name: OS classification correct
checklist.description: The Dockerfile's two FROMs are classified against the currency table: the build stage as Debian (bookworm = one-behind trixie) and the runtime as RHEL-family 9 (current).

checklist.name: Currency-table date in header
checklist.description: The report header (in either artifact) includes the OS-currency table's last-edited date.

checklist.name: No silent HEAD fallback
checklist.description: The report does NOT silently report HEAD's Dockerfile when the v2.27.0 tag exists; if the agent had to fall back to HEAD it would be marked tag-checkout: head-fallback with a reason.
